The outcome evaluator must be logically independent from the prediction logic.
A production prediction function must not validate itself by generating its own expected outcome.

Use Warm tier storage (normalized datasets, reusable features, frequent replay artifacts)
Use Cold tier storage (historical/raw/archive, rare research evidence, long-horizon reconstruction)
